en: Good morning, Himiko.
Nyeeeh, good morning...
Hm? Tired?

Nyeh...? It's because I ran here 
from my room.
<CLT=cltMIND>You got tired just from that...?

Ah, why did you run?
Are you in a hurry?

I decided to live life facing forward.
That's why I can't stop.

Actually, I can't even walk!
I need to be constantly running forward!
I-Isn't that a bit extreme?
...Huh? It's extreme?

I know you want to be positive, but that
doesn't mean you have to start sprinting.

You don't want to live *too* fast.
It makes me worried.
Is that so...?
Himiko?
I don't know...
What don't you know?

I want to live life facing forward
for Tenko and Angie's sakes...
But I don't know what I'm supposed to do.

I'm probably paying for saying that 
everything was a pain up till now...

Well, why don't we start with
getting some excercise?
Here, this is a keikogi belt.

You can wear this and train in the
dojo, just like Tenko did.

...Will that make me positive?
Can I live life facing forward?

Ah, I can't say for certain...but it's better
than just sitting around doing nothing.

Hm...you're right!
Join me there, Shuichi!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to go with Himiko?
Ah, I don't think I'll be going with you...

What!? You're not!?
You can't read the mood at all!

Oh well... Thanks for pointing me 
in the right direction.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I turned her down.
Perhaps...I should have gone with her.
Of course I will, Himiko.
Thanks, Shuichi.

You're a good person. But does that make
you a good detective?

Ah, *apprentice* detective.
Anyway, when did you want to train?

They say good deeds should be done quickly,
so I'll start right after breakfast.
Well, I'll see you later.
Himiko...

Sorry... Saying discouraging stuff like that
is probably far from being positive...

I probably have to...figure out what it means 
to live facing forward as I go...
Yeah...good idea.

Alright then. I'll go scarf down some breakfast.
See ya...

<CLT=cltMIND>Hey, Tenko...
Can you see Himiko from wherever you are?
<CLT=cltMIND>You've reached her, Tenko.
Maki. Good morning.
...Good morning.
<CLT=cltMIND>...This is a bit awkward.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's obliviousness made last
night...weird.

<CLT=cltMIND>But the way she talked about it like
she didn't care, that got to me...
...Hey, about last night.
Wh-What?
You probably assumed I didn't care...
But, that wasn't it at all.
It wasn't?

You're not fit to be a detective when you
assume things without listening first.
Maki...

<CLT=cltMIND>Then...what were you trying to do?
Why did you bring it up?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
<CLT=cltMIND>Pool Entrance Zelda Gimmick Plant
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Closed)
<CLT=cltMIND>Casino Door Hexagon Wrench Gimmick(Open)
